items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: The name 'Ruth' is mentioned by the interviewer in the context of identifying a building ('Ruth chapter of something... Masonic hall'). The interviewee does not respond to this mention, nor does the interviewee mention Ruth in any personal context.

ctx.x: Well, it ain't what it say. Not all the way.

I can't see it from here. It ain't on there. Ruth. Ruth chapter of something. Friend accepted masons, I think. There's a right one on there. That's a Masonic, huh, over there? Yeah. That's a Masonic. That's a Masonic hall over there. Yeah.
